source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the characteristics of the genetic code (PDF 132).

items: Aalamgeer (universal): code taqreeban sab jandaron mein aik hai (AGA bacteria, insanon aur sab mein arginine), isi liye genes jandaron ke darmiyan muntaqil ho sakte hain. Chand istisna hain: mitochondria ka code thora mukhtalif hai jo un ki alag irtiqai tareekh dikhata hai, aur kuch jandar jaise ciliates aur kuch viruses jaise bacteriophages mukhtalif code use karte hain.
Triplet: code teen nucleotides ke codons mein hai, jo DNA ki maloomat ko 20 qisam ke amino acids ki zaroorat se mutawazin karta hai.
Degenerate: aik se zyada codons aik hi amino acid tay kar sakte hain. Is se mutations bardasht hoti aur irtiqai lachak milti hai.
Baghair waqfe: codons musalsal parhe jate hain, darmiyan mein khaali jagah nahi.
Non-overlapping: har triplet apne parosiyon se alag parha jata hai, is liye AUGAGCGCA sirf AUG/AGC/GCA parha jata hai, kabhi AUG/UGA/GAG nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki degeneracy ki misaal
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke AUG, GUG, UUG aur CUG sab methionine ka code hain. Standard code mein sirf AUG methionine ka code hai; GUG (valine) aur UUG aur CUG (leucine) kuch bacteria mein start codon ka kaam kar sakte hain jahan woh pehla methionine late hain. Degeneracy ki saaf misaal leucine hai jis ke chhe codons hain: UUA, UUG, CUU, CUC, CUA aur CUG.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Aalamgeer code ke istisna dikhate hain ke standard code aam hone ke bawajood is mein tabdeeli aur dhalne ki gunjaish hai.

blocks.prompt: Tajziya: agar code triplet hai to cell ko kitni qisam ke tRNA chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Zyada se zyada 61, yaani 64 codons mein se teen stop codons chhor kar har aik ke liye aik, kyunke stop codons ko koi tRNA nahi parhta. Amalan cells kam se guzara karte hain kyunke kuch tRNAs aik hi amino acid ke aik se zyada codons se jur sakte hain.

items: Aalamgeer (chand istisna), triplet, degenerate, baghair waqfe, non-overlapping.
